name: NOIZ
description: Long-running party and wedding band that plays clubs, private parties and weddings from Montauk to Manhattan, in sizes from a 3-piece to a 12-piece show band with horns. Its song list covers R&B, pop, dance, Motown, disco, hip hop, Latin, calypso, reggae and swing.

dancing.notes: A wedding and party band whose song list is sorted by dance music: dance tunes, disco, Motown, Latin, swing and parent dances. A Long Island event company lists it as its evening dance band. Public shows are fewer, often afternoon waterfront or vineyard sets.
